advisories.summary: Removes the legacy pre-Bedrock import commands import-op and import-receipts-op. Also updates rustls for RUSTSEC-2026-0285 and imbl for RUSTSEC-2026-0292.
advisories.action: Operators who import pre-Bedrock OVM history with those commands must switch to the Bedrock state bootstrap before upgrading: run op-reth init-state --without-ovm, and serve pre-Bedrock history from an l2geth instance.
